title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a hands-on and proactive DevOps Engineer with 3–5 years of

experience in cloud infrastructure, AWS, CI/CD, containerization, monitoring, and

deployment automation.

The candidate will be responsible for managing and improving the infrastructure powering

Decorpot's technology platforms, including our AI-powered interior design, 3D

visualization, backend and automation systems.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to take ownership of production

infrastructure, improve deployment reliability, automate repetitive operations, and work

closely with backend and AI engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities

1. AWS Infrastructure

● Manage and maintain AWS infrastructure across development, staging, and

production environments.

● Work with services such as: EC2, ECS, S3, RDS, Lambda, Route53, ELB/ALB,

VPC, IAM, Auto Scaling, CloudWatch

● Monitor infrastructure health, availability, performance, and resource utilization.

● Support AWS cost optimization and infrastructure security initiatives.

2. CI/CD & Deployment Automation

● Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines for frontend and backend applications.

● Work with tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or AWS

CodePipeline.

● Automate application build, testing, deployment, rollback, and release processes.

● Troubleshoot deployment and pipeline failures.

3. Docker & Containerization

● Build and maintain Docker images for application services.

● Manage containerized applications using AWS ECS/ECS Fargate.

● Support Kubernetes/EKS environments where required.

● Implement appropriate resource limits, health checks, logging, and

deployment strategies.

4. Monitoring & Logging

● Implement and maintain infrastructure and application monitoring.

● Work with: AWS CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus, ELK/OpenSearch or

similar tools

● Configure alerts for infrastructure, application, database, and service-level issues.

● Participate in production incident investigation and resolution.

5. Infrastructure as Code & Automation

2

● Develop and maintain infrastructure using Terraform or CloudFormation.

● Automate routine infrastructure and operational tasks using scripting.

● Identify manual processes and convert them into reliable automation.

● Maintain proper documentation for infrastructure and operational procedures.

6. Database & Backup Operations

● Support production databases, particularly MongoDB and AWS RDS.

● Assist with:

○ Backup and restore

○ Database monitoring

○ Performance troubleshooting

○ Disaster recovery processes

● Ensure appropriate backup policies and retention mechanisms are implemented.

7. Security & Access Management

● Manage AWS IAM roles, policies, users, and access controls.

● Follow least-privilege principles.

● Support secure management of application secrets and credentials.

● Assist with VPC, security groups, network access, and infrastructure hardening.

● Follow DevOps security and operational best practices.

8. AI & Application Infrastructure

● Support deployment and operation of Python-based AI/ML services.

● Work with services built using technologies such as FastAPI, Flask, Python, and

REST APIs.

● Support infrastructure required for AI inference and asynchronous processing.

● Exposure to GPU workloads or ML infrastructure will be an advantage.

9. Messaging & Background Processing

● Support application infrastructure using technologies such as: Redis, RabbitMQ,

Kafka

● Monitor queues and background jobs and troubleshoot processing failures.

10. Collaboration & Production Support

● Work closely with backend, frontend, AI, QA, and product teams.

● Support application releases and production deployments.

● Participate in incident management and root-cause analysis.

● Maintain clear documentation for infrastructure, deployment and troubleshooting

procedures.

Required Technical Skills

1. AWS :-

Strong hands-on experience with: EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, RDS,

Route53, ELB/ALB, Lambda, ECS and Auto Scaling.

2. DevOps & CI/CD :-

Strong hands-on experience with: Jenkins / GitHub Actions / GitLab CI/CD,

Docker, Linux, Git, CI/CD pipeline development and troubleshooting

3. Infrastructure as Code :-

Terraform or AWS CloudFormation

3

4. Monitoring :-

CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus, ELK/OpenSearch or equivalent

monitoring/logging tools

5. Databases :-

MongoDB, Basic knowledge of PostgreSQL/MySQL, Backup and restore

concepts

6. Scripting :-

Bash/Shell scripting, Basic Python scripting will be an advantage

7. Networking :-

Good understanding of: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, Load Balancers, VPC,

Subnets, Security Groups, NAT/Internet Gateway

8. Containers :-

Docker, ECS/Fargate, Basic Kubernetes knowledge is preferred

9. Messaging :-

Exposure to one or more of:Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka

Good to Have

● Kubernetes / AWS EKS

● Terraform modules and reusable IaC

● AWS cost optimization

● MongoDB Atlas

● OpenSearch/ELK

● AI/ML deployment experience

● GPU infrastructure

● FastAPI/Flask deployment

● AWS Lambda automation

● EventBridge

● AWS Systems Manager

● Experience with production incident management

● Experience working with AI-powered or SaaS products

Soft Skills

● Strong ownership and accountability.

● Good troubleshooting and analytical skills.

● Ability to work independently and take responsibility for production infrastructure.

● Strong communication and collaboration skills.

● Willingness to learn new technologies.

● Good documentation and process discipline.

● Ability to remain calm and methodical during production incidents.

● Strong focus on reliability, security, and automation.

Education & Experience

● Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or

equivalent practical experience.

● 3–5 years of hands-on DevOps / Cloud / Infrastructure experience.

● Strong practical experience with AWS and Linux environments.

● Experience supporting production applications is preferred.

● Candidates with strong hands-on skills and relevant practical experience will be

considered irrespective of specific degree specialization.

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Are you fine with the budget range ?
* Please mention the relevat experince ? Total number of years
* Are you fine with Kasba location ?
* Are you fine to work from office ?

Work Location: In person

title: Site Reliability Engineer (Azure SRE & SQL)
description:
**Role description**  

### **Job Summary**

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Site Reliability Engineer with strong proficiency in Azure SRE and SQL, along with intermediate experience in Dynatrace or any similar monitoring tool. The role focuses on supporting the reliability, availability, and performance of cloud-based systems through hands-on Azure operations, troubleshooting, SQL support, monitoring, and production incident resolution.

The ideal candidate demonstrates strong ownership, practical troubleshooting skills, and the ability to proactively investigate and resolve production issues while collaborating with senior engineers.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Support day-to-day Azure SRE operations and help maintain the reliability and availability of cloud infrastructure.
* Perform hands-on Azure troubleshooting across infrastructure and application environments.
* Investigate production incidents, perform issue triage and troubleshooting, and support timely resolution and escalation.
* Perform SQL administration and production support activities.
* Troubleshoot database issues and perform SQL query analysis and performance monitoring.
* Support SQL database import/export, backups, restores, and data migration activities.
* Manage SQL database security and user access and perform basic database maintenance.
* Monitor infrastructure and applications using Dynatrace or any similar monitoring tool.
* Proactively investigate monitoring s and identify potential reliability or performance issues.
* Participate in post-incident reviews and support continuous improvement of production reliability.

### **Required Skills**

**Proficient**

* Azure SRE
* SQL

**Intermediate**

* Dynatrace or any similar monitoring tool

  
**Skills**

Azure SRE, SQL

 **About UST**  
UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Point Wild helps customers monitor, manage, and protect against the risks associated with their identities and personal information in a digital world. Backed by WndrCo, Warburg Pincus and General Catalyst, Point Wild is dedicated to creating the world's most comprehensive portfolio of industry-leading cybersecurity solutions. Our vision is to become THE go-to resource for every cyber protection need individuals may face - today and in the future.

Join us for the ride!

**About the Role:**  
  
We're looking for an experienced **DevOps Engineer** to build, operate, and optimize the cloud infrastructure and continuous-delivery systems behind our **Lat61** platform on **Google Cloud**. You'll help keep our production environments reliable, scalable, and secure, supporting smooth deployment pipelines and efficient day-to-day operations.  
  
You'll work closely with the platform team to strengthen our DevOps practices: managing infrastructure as code, automating operational workflows, and upholding our security and compliance standards. We're a high-trust, outcome-focused team that values ownership and pragmatic problem-solving.

  

**Day to Day:**

* **GCP Infrastructure & Operations:** Deploy, manage, and maintain workloads on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), under the team's architectural guidance.
* **Infrastructure as Code:** Build and maintain infrastructure with Terraform, following GitOps workflows and the team's established patterns.
* **CI/CD Pipelines:** Build and maintain automated deployment pipelines with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and ArgoCD for reliable, repeatable releases.
* **Networking & Traffic Management:** Support enterprise networking, help configure the service mesh (Istio mTLS, VirtualServices), and manage API gateways (Kong) for secure traffic routing.
* **Observability & Incident Response:** Contribute to telemetry, log aggregation, and alerting; help troubleshoot and resolve production issues.
* **Security & Compliance:** Support security controls (VPC-SC, IAM, Org Policies), manage secrets, help maintain compliance standards (e.g., SOC 2), and participate in the on-call rotation.

**What you bring to the table:**

* At least 5 years of hands-on DevOps / platform / SRE experience operating production systems.
* **GCP & Kubernetes:** Solid production experience on GCP and GKE (cluster operations, Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD).
* **Infrastructure as Code:** Strong, practical Terraform experience and GitOps workflows in a team environment.
* **CI/CD:** Proven experience designing and building multi-stage deployment pipelines.
* **Networking:** Working knowledge of Istio and API gateways (Kong), with comfort troubleshooting service-to-service communication.
* **Security:** Hands-on experience with secret management and access controls (Auth0, Dex, External Secrets, SOPS, IAM).
* **Databases:** Operational familiarity with Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL), BigQuery, and common data stores (e.g., ClickHouse / Elasticsearch).
* At least upper-intermediate spoken and written English.

**It would be great if you also had:**

* **Automation:** Pulumi/Ansible for host configuration and infrastructure automation.
* **Certifications:** GCP Associate Cloud Engineer, or a foundational Kubernetes certification (e.g., CKA / CKAD).
* **Observability tooling:** Hands-on experience with Loki, Grafana, or similar.
* **Scripting:** Bash or Python for operational tooling and automation.

**As part of Point Wild, you will:**

**Solve real customer problems**. Point Wild's point solutions allow consumers to address their immediate cyber protection needs. Our mandate is to continuously anticipate our customers' evolving digital security needs to create best-in-class solutions aimed at keeping them safe.

**See your impact.** We are a scrappy, nimble organization where individual contributions are needed and valued. You will see your impact every day.

**Accelerate your career.** As we expand, you will have the opportunity to learn new technologies, products, and markets in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

Most importantly, you'll get to work with other talented people at a company where people matter. If you want to put your fingerprint on an organization and leapfrog your growth, this is the place for you.

In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination or harassment based on "protected categories," Point Wild is committed to being an inclusive community where all feel welcome. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at Point Wild.

Important privacy information for United States based job applicants can be found here.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**About the Role**
------------------

We are seeking a DevOps Engineer to join our Product Engineering team and build the cloud platform behind the modernization of our Retail ERP platform. You will own infrastructure as code, build pipelines, release automation, deployment, monitoring, and recovery on Microsoft Azure.

This role requires strong hands-on Azure and Terraform skills and experience running PostgreSQL at scale. You will work closely with Architects, development teams, and QA to make releases to a large multi-tenant estate safe, repeatable, and fast.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, build, and maintain Azure infrastructure using Terraform (Container Apps, Application Gateway, PostgreSQL Flexible Server, Key Vault, networking, and storage).
* Set up and manage CI/CD runners and shared pipeline templates in GitHub Actions for all development teams.
* Build and operate release automation that applies database migrations (Flyway) to a large number of client databases in controlled groups.
* Automate deployment to development, staging, and production environments.
* Set up monitoring, logging, alerting, and dashboards; take part in on-call during major releases.
* Plan and run backup, restore, and disaster recovery drills; maintain runbooks.
* Manage secrets, access control, and environment security.
* Profile database estates (size, growth, load) and support test environments built from masked data.
* Optimize cloud cost, capacity, and performance.

**Required Technical Skills**
-----------------------------

### **Cloud**

* 4+ years of hands-on DevOps / platform engineering experience.
* Strong experience with Microsoft Azure (Container Apps or AKS, networking, Key Vault, storage, Application Gateway).

### **Infrastructure as Code**

* Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, including modules, state management, and environment promotion.

### **CI/CD**

* Strong experience with GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, including self-hosted runners and reusable pipeline templates.
* Experience automating releases across many environments or tenants.

### **Database Operations**

* Hands-on experience operating PostgreSQL: backup, restore, replication, and performance basics.
* Experience with database migration tools such as Flyway or Liquibase.

### **Containers & Scripting**

* Hands-on experience with Docker and containerized deployments.
* Scripting with Bash, PowerShell, or Python.

### **Monitoring & Security**

* Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Azure Monitor, Grafana, OpenTelemetry or similar).
* Good understanding of cloud security, secrets management, and access control.

**Team Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Provide shared pipelines, environments, and standards that development teams can use on their own.
* Review infrastructure changes and enforce best practices.
* Support development teams during releases and production incidents.
* Document infrastructure, runbooks, and processes.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

* Experience running multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
* Experience with Kubernetes (AKS).
* Experience with disaster recovery across regions.
* Comfortable using AI tools to write and review infrastructure code.
* Exposure to retail, ERP, or POS systems.

**Educational Qualification**
-----------------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

**What You'll Work On**
-----------------------

* Cloud Platform for an Enterprise Retail ERP
* Infrastructure as Code on Microsoft Azure
* CI/CD and Release Automation
* Database Release Automation across a Multi-tenant Estate
* Monitoring and Observability
* Backup and Disaster Recovery
* Cloud-native Modernization Initiatives

**What We Look For**
--------------------

* Strong hands-on automation mindset.
* Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Care for reliability, security, and repeatability.
* Ownership mindset with a focus on delivering business value.
* Good communication with development teams.

**Why Join Us**
---------------

* Opportunity to modernize a large-scale enterprise Retail ERP platform.
* Work on cloud-native, event-driven, and distributed systems.
* Solve challenging scalability and performance problems.
* Collaborate with experienced architects and product engineering teams.
* Play a key role in shaping the technical direction of a mission-critical product.

title: Enterprise Platform Architect DevOps
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------

**About this opportunity**

Join our team as an Architect – AI and DevOps, helping define and deliver secure, scalable and cost-effective AI solutions for enterprise environments. You will shape architectural standards and guide the adoption of Generative AI, large language models, intelligent agents and automation across technology platforms and delivery processes.

Working with engineering, product, security and platform teams, you will connect strategic goals with practical solutions that are reliable, maintainable and ready for production.

**What you will do**

Define end-to-end AI and machine learning architectures that meet requirements for performance, availability, security, scalability and cost.  
Design enterprise solutions using large language models, prompt engineering, model tuning, efficient model deployment and secure integration.  
Consulting & Business Generation: Work with Customer Units to propose Automation and AI Solutions & capabilities in the Telecom Service Domain. Contribute to creation of End to end solution, presales estimates and work on Statement of Work and compliance document.  
Architect knowledge solutions using Retrieval-Augmented Generation, embeddings, vector databases and semantic search.  
Design intelligent agents, tool integrations and workflow orchestration using APIs and the Model Context Protocol.  
Establish standards for automated delivery pipelines covering source control, testing, security checks, artifact management, deployment and validation.  
Design cloud-native solutions using AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes and microservices.  
Guide infrastructure automation, configuration management and Infrastructure as Code using Ansible and related tools.  
Embed privacy, access control, security, compliance and responsible AI practices, including human approval where appropriate.  
Promote effective monitoring, logging, performance improvement and production troubleshooting.  
Communicate architectural decisions clearly and support teams in delivering consistent, high-quality solutions.

**You will bring**

Experience designing and implementing enterprise AI, machine learning, cloud or DevOps solutions.  
Strong understanding of AI and machine learning architecture, deep learning, large language models and modern AI applications.  
Proficiency in Python and practical experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow.  
Experience with prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, embeddings, vector databases, model integration and performance optimization.  
Knowledge of AI agent frameworks, workflow orchestration, tool calling, API integration and the Model Context Protocol.  
Hands-on experience with Git, Ansible, CI/CD design, Python or Bash scripting, JSON and YAML. GitLab experience is an advantage.  
Familiarity with code quality and security tools, artifact repositories and container registries.  
Experience with AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, networking and identity management.  
Knowledge of Ubuntu and Red Hat Enterprise Linux environments, monitoring, logging, observability and production support.  
Strong communication, collaboration and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work across technical and business teams.

title: Salesforce Devops
description:
CXCRM Recruitment

Dear Candidate  
Greetings from Cognizant!!

**Job Title:** Salesforce DevOps Developer

**Experience:** 4 to 12 years

**Location:** All CTS Location (3 days office, Hybrid mode)

**Notice Period:** Immediate to 90 days

#### **Job Summary**

We are looking for a skilled **Salesforce DevOps Developer** with strong Salesforce development expertise and hands-on experience in DevOps, CI/CD, version control, and release management. The ideal candidate will be responsible for automating deployments, streamlining development processes, and ensuring high-quality Salesforce releases across environments.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement Salesforce DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
* Develop and customize Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce APIs.
* Manage source code repositories using Git, GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket.
* Automate deployments using Salesforce DX (SFDX), Copado, Gearset, AutoRABIT, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.
* Perform code reviews and enforce development best practices.
* Manage branching, merging, release strategies, and environment synchronization.
* Work closely with developers, QA teams, and business stakeholders to ensure smooth releases.
* Troubleshoot deployment issues and optimize release processes.
* Implement security, compliance, and governance standards across Salesforce environments.
* Support Agile development and DevOps transformation initiatives.
